info.title: tamp
info.description: Preview. Migrates a NUKE 8+ build to Tamp (ADR 0021); run it as `tamp migrate nuke`. A syntactic Roslyn rewrite that applies the auto-tier rows of the NUKE-to-Tamp mapping, leaves a // TAMP-MIGRATE(rule-id) marker at every site it won't touch, and writes a coverage report. It never compiles or restores the NUKE build.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Preview. Rewrites a NUKE build to Tamp in place: its C# files, its build project, and the
tamp init bootstrap (tamp.sh, tamp.cmd, the dotnet-tamp tool entry). Auto-tier mappings are
applied; every other recognised site gets a // TAMP-MIGRATE(<id>) marker. Writes
tamp-migration.json and tamp-migration.md to the root.

options.name: --build-dir
options.description: the NUKE build project's directory, relative to the root (default: build)

options.name: --allow-dirty
options.description: run even if the git working tree has uncommitted changes

options.name: --package-major
options.description: major for versioned wrappers, e.g. 8 for Tamp.NetCli.V8 (default: newest)

options.name: --tamp-version
options.description: version for the Tamp package references (default: this tool's version)
